name: Solstice Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Darkness.

Replacement Power: You gain Eclipsed Spell as a bonus feat. In addition, the following granted power replaces the touch of darkness power of the Darkness domain.

Winter Lights (Sp)

At will, you can illuminate a living plant or plant creature you touch with many multicolored tiny spheres. This functions as the light spell. In addition, you can discharge the spell’s power into a shooting star that inflicts 1d6 points of fire damage +1 for every two cleric levels you possess to a single foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. You can use this ability for a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st-goodberry, 2nd-motes of dusk and dawn, 5th-heroes’ feast, 7th-changestaff.
